Drop skill_read_artifact_number from the residual list

deviations.description: Add a group that sources the resolved skill-base.sh (that suite already resolves it)
deviations.reason: The suite's default SKILL_BASE resolution is deploy-tree-first (.claude/scripts/skill-base.sh before the source-store copy), and Phase 5's redeploy has not run yet, so the deployed copy is still the pre-fix code. A deploy-first resolution would have silently exercised the OLD skill_read_artifact_number() and reported a false PASS. Followed Group 5's existing precedent instead (a dedicated source-store-first ARTIFACT_SKILL_BASE variable, sourced fresh inside each case's own subshell, never at suite level) -- the same mechanism that suite already documents for exactly this hazard.
